description:

 4-7 years
 

 Must have:
 

 C#
 

 MVC(onshore 2+ years, offshore 1+ years)
 

 JavaScript/ JQuery
 

 .NET
 

 SQL (TSQL, Stored Procedures, Views, etc.)
 

 Agile experience
 

 Windows Work flow foundation(1+ year for at least one resource)
 

 Nice to have:
 

 Telerik Kendo UI, Telerik Just Mock, Telerik ORM
 

 SSIS
 

 SSRS

 Good education or equivalent
 

 Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year college or university or better
 

 Or, extremely good on at least one of the “must-haves” to compensate lack of formal education.
